name: 磁吸滑钮开合随行杯款
description: 滑钮开合顶盖、分件平铺讲结构、微距证做工、空白标注收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, split screens and spec screens; warm stone-grey #F2EFE9 for benefit and detail screens; weathered dark walnut plank #4A382A only for the single lifestyle scene
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral soft studio light, large front-left key with a low fill card, controlled speculars on brushed metal, soft contact shadows, no harsh hotspots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale stone board #F2EFE9 for studio screens, weathered dark walnut plank #4A382A for the scene
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif held for post-composed copy only; all in-image words stay as blank frames
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line icons in deep steel-blue #1D3557, one icon per screen maximum
styleLock.presentationRules: the vessel stays upright and full-height at one stable scale; the same slight 3/4 or straight-on reading angle repeats across screens; separated parts lie on one shared plane
noDrift: no rendered words, numbers or units anywhere in frame
no brand marks or embossed lettering on any part
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent rugged-premium drinkware e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm stone-grey #F2EFE9, charcoal #26282B and one deep steel-blue accent #1D3557; neutral soft studio lighting with a large front-left key, low fill card and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif held for post-composed copy only; single-weight thin-line icon style in the accent colour; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic blocks and empty label frames; stable upright product scale and one consistent slight 3/4 or straight-on reading angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered words or numbers.

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼，用干净直身轮廓与完整顶盖赢下点击
shots.camera: dead-on straight-on eye-level view, vessel standing upright, full height and closure top visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, large front key with a soft fill card, controlled specular on the metal band, single soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: even margin all round, no extra whitespace block reserved
shots.promptTemplate: Clean marketplace packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The vessel stands upright and centred, photographed dead-on at eye level so its full height and its closure top read clearly. Bright even high-key studio light from a large front key with a soft fill card, one controlled specular along the metal band, one soft contact shadow under the base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with an even margin and no reserved copy block. Negative: no brand mark, wordmark or embossed lettering on any surface, no props, no hands, no watermark, no tinted or gradient background, no cropped rim or base, no floating product without a contact shadow, no mirrored or duplicated vessel.

shots.displayName: 顶盖闭合结构俯角特写
shots.intent: 承接首图，一眼交代顶部闭合结构与金属边圈质感
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down onto the closure top, body falling away beneath it
shots.lighting: soft top light sweeping across the transparent cover, low fill from the right, gentle specular streaks
shots.whitespace: generous clean margin on the lower right for copy
shots.promptTemplate: Structure detail screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down onto the closure top of the upright vessel, the body falling away below it. Soft top light sweeping across the transparent cover to reveal its concentric ridges, low fill from the right, gentle specular streaks on the metal ring. Background warm stone-grey #F2EFE9. The closure area occupies 55-60% of the frame with generous clean negative space on the lower right for copy. Negative: no readable lettering or embossed logo on the sliding tab, no fingerprints, dust or scratches on the transparent cover, no cracked or yellowed plastic, no blown-out highlights, no extra text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 拆件平铺讲清盖体机构，回答好不好清洗的疑虑
shots.camera: flat lay panorama shot straight down from a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: even high-key flat studio light from above, soft even shadows, no directional drama
shots.props: the removable cover and one detached small sliding part laid on the same plane
shots.whitespace: wide open white space on the upper band for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce exploded-parts flat lay of {product}, shot straight down from a 90-degree overhead angle: the round cover component sits on the left and its one detached small sliding part rests beside it on the same plane. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat studio light from directly above, soft even contact shadows, no directional drama. Background seamless pure white #FFFFFF. The laid-out parts occupy 35-40% of the frame overall, leaving wide open whitespace across the upper band. One thin-line icon in deep steel-blue #1D3557 may sit in the upper band as an empty mark, with no words rendered. Negative: no brand lettering on the sliding part, no mould lines or injection gates, no missing screws or broken clips, no scattered extras, no rendered text, no watermark, no tilted perspective.

shots.intent: 微距证明滑钮与盖体的做工与耐用质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom from a very low angle skimming across the cover surface, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft sweeping side light from the left revealing fine surface grain, controlled specular roll-off
shots.background: warm stone-grey #F2EFE9 falling out of focus
shots.whitespace: minimal margin, the detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the small sliding tab seated in the transparent cover, camera at a very low angle skimming across the cover surface with shallow depth of field and the near edge sharp. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft sweeping side light from the left to bring out fine surface grain and the crisp moulded edge, speculars rolling off gently. Background warm stone-grey #F2EFE9 falling out of focus. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal surrounding margin. Negative: no blurry subject, no embossed lettering or logo on the tab, no shiny new-plastic look, no dust or fibres, no duplicated rings in the bokeh, no extra text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 把产品放进真实桌面休闲场景，让买家自我代入
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level framing with a candid handheld feel, product placed to the right third
shots.lighting: warm low-key directional light from the upper left against a dark setting, neutral balance held on the product, soft falloff
shots.background: weathered dark walnut plank table #4A382A with a dark blurred interior behind
shots.props: a few blank rectangular game tiles on the table, one pair of adult hands and shirt sleeves only
shots.whitespace: none, the table and hands fill the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} standing on the right third of a weathered dark walnut plank table #4A382A while a tabletop tile game is played. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 eye-level framing with a candid handheld feel and a touch of film grain. Warm low-key directional light from the upper left against a dark blurred interior, neutral balance kept on the product, soft falloff into shadow, a believable contact shadow under the base. Props: a few blank rectangular game tiles scattered on the table and one pair of adult hands with shirt sleeves entering from the top of frame, no face visible. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with no reserved copy block. Negative: no identifiable face or model identity, no deformed or extra fingers, no hand covering the product, no brand mark or corner wordmark, no glossy perfect table, no impossible reflections, no text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用空白引线承接规格疑虑，具体数值一律留给买家自填
shots.camera: dead-on straight-on elevation view, vessel upright and fully inside the frame
shots.lighting: flat even high-key light with no dramatic shadow, thin linework reading cleanly
shots.props: empty dimension leader lines with blank end caps, one thin-line material icon at the left
shots.whitespace: clear side gutters on the left and right reserved for labels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce specification screen for {product}: a clean semi-technical upright rendering of the vessel, photographed dead-on in a straight-on elevation view, surrounded by empty dimension leader lines with blank rounded end caps at the top, side and base. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat even high-key lighting with no dramatic shadow so the linework reads clearly. Background seamless pure white #FFFFFF. One thin-line icon in deep steel-blue #1D3557 sits in the left gutter above an empty rounded label frame. The rendering occupies 50-60% of the frame with clear side gutters reserved for labels. Negative: no numbers, units or measurement values rendered anywhere, no material grade or alloy stamp, no brand wordmark, no dimension line crossing the product body, no dense body text, no warped straight lines, no watermark.

shots.intent: 以并列排版的安心卖点结构与空白印章框收口，消除下单风险
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, vessel upright on the left half of the frame
shots.lighting: soft front-left key with low fill, controlled specular on the metal band, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one thin-line icon above an empty rounded label frame, one empty seal outline on the right half
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 40% for copy and one icon
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust close for {product}, shown at a slight 3/4 hero angle and standing upright on the left half of the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft front-left key with low fill, one controlled specular on the metal band, a soft contact shadow grounding the base. Background warm stone-grey #F2EFE9. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous negative space across the right 40% holding one thin-line icon in deep steel-blue #1D3557, one empty rounded label frame and one empty seal outline for post-composed copy. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, test results, ratings, awards or seal lettering; no rendered words, no fake badge or logo, no clutter overlapping the product, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 白底直身杯正视图；02 高俯角看透明顶盖与金属边圈；03 杯盖与滑钮分件正上方平铺；04 滑钮表面微距；05 深色木桌桌面棋类陪伴场景（仅见双手与前臂）；06 半技术渲染带三条尺寸引线与材料图标；07 杯体居左、右侧线条图标加安心主张并列。品类判定依据：主体为带透明顶盖与滑钮的直身随身杯，无电加热与电机，属家居日用的水具餐具；不判运动户外/运动水壶，因全套画面均为桌面日常与清洁结构场景，无运动装备语境；源类目提示与判定一致。已剥离内容：杯身凹印字标、滑钮上的浮雕字样与角标字样、原英文主张与图标配文、材料牌号数字、三条引线上的尺寸数值（改为空白端帽引线）、场景人物身份与左上角标识字样；全部具体数值与主张以空白占位框承载，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
